impact_assessment.why: The five planned milestones cannot pass Phase 4 separately because the code, README, knowledge and map must change together for the freshness, command and claim gates.
impact_assessment.benefits: One atomic, gate-passing commit instead of intermediate states whose docs still describe the deleted AI review.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the CLI drops AI options and state key ai becomes review; dependency: none; concurrency: unchanged; state: schema 2 remains readable with legacy ai fallback.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Full Phase 4 triad passed; explicit staging; ADR-263 records the removed path and the new packet contract.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Finish the host-review pivot and remove the AI orchestration

impact_assessment.why: Reforge accumulated an AI review subsystem (model budgets, argv attachment, request caps, redaction and evidence rules) that duplicated what the driving agent already does; the operator wants the host agent to analyze the packet directly, with no subagents.
impact_assessment.benefits: One explicit packet/findings contract; no model calls or credentials; less code and fewer failure modes; the widening-window engine, safe repairs and delivery stay.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CLI AI options disappear and state key ai becomes review; dependency: no new deps; concurrency: unchanged per-project lock; state: schema 2 stays readable, new entries use review and old ai entries are read as fallback.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep run/audit/fix semantics, add findings-file validation tests, update README/architecture/services/SKILL, append one superseding ADR, and run the full gate triad.
